verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own docs describe Repository Agent, a built-in conversational AI assistant that can browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push. That is direct delegation of repository tasks inside the app, and it is reinforced by the 'Code Agent' homepage mention and AI commit-message suggestions. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of agent scope, approval or review controls and model/provider details, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent working as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
Code Agent & commit suggestions. Respects your data with opt-in.
includes the ability to suggest messages using artificial intelligence.
